title: Every ergodic interval exchange transformation is minimal
author: Przemyslaw Berk; Frank Trujillo
work: Ergodic properties of infinite extension of symmetric interval exchange transformations
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 321-323: an interval exchange transformation ergodic with respect to Lebesgue measure is minimal. The proof (source lines 325-337), which the author includes for completeness, does not use the definition of minimality directly: it proves the equivalent formulation by approximation, which forces the introduction of the first return map to a short interval, the maximum of the finitely many return times of that induced map, the finite set of iterates of the discontinuities up to that maximum, and a choice of a point of continuity of the induced map, which is available because the set of such points has full measure. The statement records only ergodicity and minimality.

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the labelled lemma, retained line for line
